title: Knowledge Retrieval/Router described as built-in agents
reality: v2.3.0 moved all optional agents into downloadable packages in the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents catalog (29 first-party packages; fresh installs contain no optional agents). Knowledge Retrieval (`knowledge-retrieval`) and Knowledge Router (`knowledge-router`) are downloadable Writer Agent packages installed via Agents -> Download Agents, not built-in agents. Verified against the Marinara-Agents catalog README.
fix: In the 'Knowledge Retrieval, Router & Sources' section, change '`knowledge-retrieval` built-in agent' and '`knowledge-router` built-in agent' to describe them as downloadable Writer Agent packages from the official Marinara-Agents catalog (Agents -> Download Agents). State that fresh v2.3+ installs have no optional agents, so semantic lorebook retrieval requires installing the package first; existing installs migrated their agents automatically.

title: Lorebook Keeper is now a downloadable agent package
reality: In v2.3.0 Lorebook Keeper became a downloadable Misc Agent package (`lorebook-keeper`) in the Marinara-Agents catalog; it is absent on fresh installs, and Game setup only shows its controls when the package is installed (2.3.0 fixed list).
fix: Where the skill references Lorebook Keeper (the `locked` field row 'Protect from agent edits (e.g., Lorebook Keeper)' and the v2.1 entry-length note about `save_lorebook_entry` / 'the Lorebook Keeper agent'), add that as of v2.3.0 Lorebook Keeper is a downloadable Misc Agent package installed via Agents -> Download Agents and is not present on fresh installs; its Game-setup controls appear only when installed.

title: Missing semantic-similarity baseline calibration (#3627)
reality: v2.3.0 (#3627) calibrated Lorebook semantic similarity against an unrelated-text baseline, so embedding models whose raw cosine scores cluster around ~0.97 no longer inject unrelated entries at every usable threshold or suppress relevant entries near 1.0.
fix: In the Embeddings / '(v2.2) Vector search as keyword-miss fallback' part of the semantic-matching section, add a v2.3.0 note: similarity scores are now calibrated against an unrelated-text baseline, so thresholds behave sensibly even with embedding models that produce tightly clustered raw cosine scores; users no longer need to hand-tune extreme thresholds (e.g. 0.97+) for such models.

title: Noodle lorebook context budget now fixed 8192 tokens
reality: v2.3.2 changed Noodle refreshes so world/lore context and chat carryover each get a fixed 8,192-token budget (so large invited rosters cannot inflate generations), superseding the v2.2 description of a Noodle-specific budget that scales with active character count. Additionally, #3687 (2.3.2) resolves active Persona, Character, and linked-lorebook macros before Noodle refresh prompts reach the model.
fix: Update the '(v2.2)' Noodle paragraph in the Scope section: replace 'a Noodle-specific token budget that scales with active character count' with the v2.3.2 behavior — world/lore (lorebook) context has a fixed 8,192-token budget per Noodle refresh (chat carryover has its own separate 8,192-token budget) — and note that linked-lorebook macros are resolved before Noodle refresh prompts are sent (#3687).

title: Missing macro resolution in lorebook routing/embedding scans (#3704)
reality: v2.3.2 (#3704) resolves `{{user}}`, `{{char}}`, and other prompt macros at the final provider boundary, explicitly including lorebook routing and embedding scans, so late injections (opening greetings, /guided instructions) no longer expose raw identity placeholders to keyword or semantic matching.
fix: Add a note in the keyword-matching or semantic-matching section: as of v2.3.2, lorebook keyword routing and embedding scans operate on macro-resolved text — entries keyed on the actual persona/character names will match content that was authored with `{{user}}`/`{{char}}` macros (greetings, /guided), and authors should key on real names, not macro literals.

title: Missing editor undo/redo and Tab indent (2.3.2)
reality: v2.3.2 restored native undo and redo in shared text editors, including lorebook Content and Description fields, and made Tab / Shift+Tab indent or unindent every selected line without replacing the selection.
fix: Add to the 'Editor conveniences' section: (v2.3.2) lorebook Content and Description editors support native undo/redo and Tab / Shift+Tab multi-line indent/unindent.

title: Missing Lorebook Prompt Position control (2.3.3)
reality: v2.3.3 (#3733) references a native 'Lorebook Prompt Position' selector in the shared Lorebook editor shell — a lorebook-level prompt-position control that the skill never mentions (it only documents the per-entry `position` 0/1/2 field).
fix: In the UI Location / editor section (or near the per-entry `position` field docs), mention the lorebook editor's 'Lorebook Prompt Position' selector as the lorebook-level control governing where lorebook content sits in the prompt, distinct from per-entry `position` overrides.

title: Missing Professor Mari atomic entry saves (#3674)
reality: #3674 fixed Professor Mari returning blank character/lorebook generation turns and made her lorebook creation save generated entries atomically (no partial entry sets on failure).
fix: In the 'AI-assisted lorebook creation (Professor Mari)' section, add: generated entries are saved atomically (all-or-nothing), and the earlier blank-generation-turn bug is fixed (#3674).

title: Missing lorebook-link duplicate protection (2.3.0)
reality: v2.3.0 made file-native primary and natural-key constraints enforceable during atomic inserts/updates, preventing lorebook links (among others) from persisting ambiguous duplicates (part of removing the retired database compatibility stack; storage is now file-native throughout).
fix: In the Scope or 'Character Lorebook tab' section, add a brief v2.3.0 note: lorebook links are now protected by file-native unique-key constraints, so the same lorebook can no longer end up ambiguously double-linked; storage is file-native (the old database compatibility stack was removed).

title: Missing entry filter chips in lorebook editor
reality: A v2.3.0 fix ('Lorebook entry filter chips now use consistent inset-safe borders so character, tag, generation, and additional-source choices are no longer clipped') confirms the lorebook editor has entry filter chips for character, tag, generation-trigger, and additional-source filters — a filtering surface the skill's editor/UI sections do not mention.
fix: Add a bullet to 'Editor conveniences': the entry list can be filtered via chips by character filter, tag, generation trigger, and additional matching sources.
